steps.content:
Several days later, N.F. 115
4:00 PM
The MBCC's Reception Room
You enter the reception room. The first thing that catches your eye is an elderly man surrounded by several caregivers.

His body is bony and gaunt as he lies amid an array of medical equipment. Multiple IV lines run into various blood vessels throughout his body, keeping him alive. The cardiac monitor emits a steady, rhythmic beeping.
A woman in purple steps forward from the delegation. She extends her hand courteously to shake yours, then speaks in rather fluent DisCity tongue.

steps.speaker: Ziyi
steps.content: Greetings, Chief. Thank you for taking the time to meet with us despite your busy schedule.

steps.speaker: Ziyi
steps.content: My name is Wei Ziyi. I'm the proprietor of Hengyun Hall, an apothecary in Eastia. This is my great-granduncle, Mr. Wei Weixiao, who founded our establishment.
Noticing your puzzled expression, she calmly offers an explanation.

steps.speaker: Ziyi
steps.content: My great-granduncle, brother of my great-grandfather, has never married. He raised me as his own daughter and the eventual successor to take over Hengyun Hall.

steps.speaker: Ziyi
steps.content: During the Wisteria Mania incident, Miss Du Ruo made a special visit to our apothecary to discuss possible solutions. As one of the few witnesses of the Perishing Star, my great-granduncle's journals proved invaluable.

steps.speaker: Ziyi
steps.content: By the way, he's 119 years old.

steps.speaker: Ziyi
steps.content: Yes, 119. He's approaching his 120th year. As the founder of Hengyun Hall, he's mastered the art of longevity through his medical expertise. Even by Eastian standards, his age is quite remarkable.
You find yourself filled with profound respect for this elderly gentleman and his pharmaceutical enterprise.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Thank you for sharing the historical information. It has been tremendously helpful for our operations.

steps.speaker: Ziyi
steps.content: You're too kind. My great-granduncle is quite sentimental about the old days. He often told us stories about the fetes he visited in his youth and the wish-granting Wisteria Fairy. Such traditions have become rare in modern Eastia as disasters make travel rather difficult these days.

steps.speaker: Ziyi
steps.content: That's why the news of the legendary Wisteria Fairy appearing in DisCity has caused such excitement among us. Even my great-granduncle seems to have regained some vigor at the news. He wishes to see it himself, and he's delighted that we can be of assistance in this matter.

steps.speaker: Ziyi
steps.content: Later, we learned that the Wisteria Fairy had stayed behind and was revealed to be a Sinner. Naturally, we want to do what we can to help with her recuperation.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Does that mean you know of ways to help her?

steps.speaker: Ziyi
steps.content: Indeed. I've already visited the quarantine zone, but I heard you brought back something crucial, Chief...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Yes, please come with me.
[Scene transition: Chief's Office]
You lead everyone to your office and pick up the wisteria branch from your desk, briefly explaining the situation.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I used to be able to communicate with her spirit through this branch. Though I don't understand the exact mechanism, she's told me things about Eastia that I won't otherwise know, so I don't think it's just my imagination.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: But lately, even this connection has grown weak. I haven't been able to see her these past few days. The branch has stopped growing, and the quarantine zone has been inactive... It's deeply concerning.
You think it all started after she kicked you out last time. Since then, no matter what you try, you haven't been able to reach Yingying.
It's one thing if she's just being stubborn and refusing your Qi. It's another if something happened to her on the other side, leaving her unable to answer you. You're worried.
While you're lost in thought, the elderly man's eyes flicker. Slightly agitated, he tugs at Ziyi's clothes and shakily points to his luggage.

steps.speaker: Ziyi
steps.content: I understand, Grandpa. Leave it to me.
Wei Ziyi retrieves a small ceramic urn from the luggage and immediately removes its lid, revealing what's inside.
A handful of earth.

steps.speaker: Ziyi
steps.content: Please replace the soil with this, and we'll observe what happens.
Wei Ziyi nods, and a scholarly-looking man steps forward from among her companions.
With utmost care, he lifts the glass cover protecting Yingying's branch, then takes out his tools to remove some of the old soil from the pot.
He replaces the old soil with the earth from Eastia, then thoroughly waters the newly repotted plant.
There's no need to check the readings. Your shackles are already reacting.
The once-fading presence, which seemed ready to vanish at any moment, now awakens and becomes deeply connected with you.
The branch begins emanating a faint trace of Mania.
It gradually fills the entire office, and then...

steps.speaker: Ziyi
steps.content: ...Is it working?
As a pure floral fragrance fills the air, everyone present seems to hear the gentle voice of the Wisteria Fairy.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Hehe... I can smell the scent of my homeland. Are you also from... Eastia?

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Please accept this wisteria as my greeting gift, and may peace and fortune be with you always!
In the crowded reception room, wisteria petals appear from nowhere, drifting down softly onto everyone's shoulders.
While the others are still in awe, Wei Ziyi gently picks up the wisteria petal from her shoulder and places it back in the flowerpot in your hands.

steps.speaker: Ziyi
steps.content: Just as expected.

steps.speaker: Ziyi
steps.content: Chief, in Eastia, we have this old saying: Two trees of the same kind, when planted in different soils, may produce different fruits. It means that the fate of something depends on the environment it is placed in.

steps.speaker: Ziyi
steps.content: Even within our vast country, a fruit from the south cannot survive in the north. Similarly, I believe it's this environmental incompatibility with DisCity that has left Yingying in such a weakened state.

steps.speaker: Ziyi
steps.content: It's not just the climate and soil. It's the culture, the people, the diet, the medical practices, and even the Mania-contaminated environment near the Black Ring. All these factors are impeding her recovery.

steps.speaker: Ziyi
steps.content: As it happens, my great-granduncle has a habit of carrying an urn of soil from home whenever he travels to ease his homesickness. This may now help prove our theory.

steps.speaker: Ziyi
steps.content: But... it remains just a handful of soil. It's far from enough.
She stares at the flower branch, her brow furrowed.

steps.speaker: Ziyi
steps.content: Yingying is from Eastia. Not just by birth, but in her very essence. That's why her body naturally thrives better in Eastia's environment.

steps.speaker: Ziyi
steps.content: If she stays in DisCity, she might live on, but she could remain in this state for years—decades, even—without improving. Taking her back to Eastia might be our best chance at her recovery.
All eyes turn to you. You've interrupted the discussion, but now you find yourself at a loss for words.
After a brief silence, you begin.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Eastia is far away, and bringing her back would involve significant risks. We'll first need more comprehensive proof.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Regarding Yingying... she is the oldest living Sinner we've ever known. She has survived numerous Mania-contaminated environments over the past century. She is invaluable to DisCity.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: We need more information to prove your claims about environmental compatibility and Mania exposure. There are also the issues of security protocols during her transfer, risk management measures, and methods to control her internal Mania...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Yes, she needs the shackles to stabilize her Mania levels. She's staying here for a reason.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I apologize if this sounds harsh, but Yingying is crucial to me... to this city, and even to all of humanity. I believe such stringent measures are absolutely necessary.
You barely register your own words. You just know that they need to be said.

steps.speaker: Ziyi
steps.content: ...Your points are entirely valid. These details certainly need to be included in the proposal, and we have much work ahead of us. However, before we continue, please allow me to ask this:

steps.speaker: Ziyi
steps.content: Do you not trust us?

steps.speaker: Ziyi
steps.content: Do those who govern DisCity believe Eastians have ulterior motives? Is that why you are so wary of us?

steps.speaker: Option
options: Let's hear what Yingying herself has to say.

choices.text: Let's hear what Yingying herself has to say.

steps.content: You gesture at the flower branch in your hand. Out of everything you've said, this sentence feels the most genuine.

steps.speaker: Ziyi
steps.content: I understand. Let's call it a day. We'll go back to refine our proposal and continue our discussion with you later.

steps.speaker: Ziyi
steps.content: Our sincerity is what has driven us here. This has been my great-granduncle's cherished wish for many years. If there's any way to prove we are sincere, we are willing to do it.

steps.speaker: Ziyi
steps.content: We truly hope she can recover and return to her homeland.
...Their sincerity is hard to doubt.
But at the thought of Yingying leaving DisCity, you feel an inexplicable emptiness and unease in your heart.
You can't even understand why yourself.

steps.speaker: Old Man
steps.content: You do not distrust us... nor are you being too careful...
Just as you are about to leave, the old man speaks up.
His voice is hoarse and hollow, as if it has traversed ages.

steps.speaker: Old Man
steps.content: You just... don't want to part with her, that's all.

steps.speaker: Old Man
steps.content: I understand, I do... But how long can you wait? And Yingying... how long can she wait?

steps.speaker: Old Man
steps.content: Will you keep waiting until you're old and dying... Will you still be telling that young sprout then... Just a little longer...
He gazes at you with eyes that seem to have glimpsed the truth of time.

steps.speaker: Old Man
steps.content: Life is... too short... If you don't start running now, you might never... reach where you want to go...
His words and gaze strike your heart like a sledgehammer.
Coughing, the old man lies back down and closes his eyes.
After seeing Wei's group off, you examine the wisteria branch in your hand once more. However, as if that brief moment of manifestation has drained all her energy, the branch has fallen silent again.
That night

steps.speaker: Wuhuanzi
steps.content: Treating her with the right environment? Hmm... It's true that some Eastians buy into that theory.

steps.speaker: Wuhuanzi
steps.content: When they travel, they pack months' worth of provisions, both food and drink, as they often struggle to adjust to unfamiliar environments.

steps.speaker: Wuhuanzi
steps.content: Some elderly travelers, those who've come to terms with their mortality, carry an urn of soil from their homeland. It not only helps make adaptation easier, but also ensures that they can return to their roots like falling leaves should any accidents happen during the journey.

steps.speaker: Wuhuanzi
steps.content: At his age, that old man traveled such a long way just to see the wisteria, and he even gave you his precious soil... Hmm... he must be a good person.

steps.speaker: Wuhuanzi
steps.content: Two trees of the same kind may yield different fruits when planted in different soils. The laws of nature vary from one place to another, and so do plants grown in different environments.

steps.speaker: Wuhuanzi
steps.content: Wisteria requires four essential elements to grow: soil, water, air, and sunlight.

steps.speaker: Wuhuanzi
steps.content: This city is far from Eastia, so naturally the soil is different. It's only normal that the wisteria is having trouble adapting.

steps.speaker: Option
options: You could have told me that sooner.

choices.text: You could have told me that sooner.

steps.speaker: Wuhuanzi
steps.content: What difference would it have made? You wouldn't have let her go anyway.

steps.speaker: Wuhuanzi
steps.content: You were right to turn those people down today though. Too risky. As for whether this treatment is worth trying... that's all up to Yingying. Have you asked her about it?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...She can't answer me right now.
Since that encounter earlier today, the wisteria branch has become completely unresponsive. Only when transplanted into Eastian soil did it show some signs of revival.

steps.speaker: Wuhuanzi
steps.content: Sounds pretty bad... But don't worry, I'm here and I won't let her die. That being said... ahem, I can't predict exactly when she'll wake up.
Over these past few days, Wuhuanzi has drilled holes around the roots of the ancient wisteria, irrigating it with medicinal solutions.
The medicine and the Qi you've been transferring to Yingying are what's keeping the millennium-old Wisteria alive.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Let me ask one last question. Setting aside all personal factors, tell me honestly: Would returning to Eastia give her a better chance of recovery?

steps.speaker: Wuhuanzi
steps.content: Since you're being so direct... Yes, I'm certain of it.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...I understand. Thank you.
[Scene transition: MBCC entrance]
Back at the MBCC's entrance, you see Nightingale coming toward you hurriedly.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Chief! Miss Wei just called. She wanted us to send someone to the Eastian Guildhall asap.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Both Yingying and Mr. Wei have gone missing!
